Please come join us in MARIANNA this Saturday, May 30, for another stop on our Defending the Florida Dream tour. 

Doors open at 11:00 AM CT - we’ll see you there.

RSVP HERE: eventbrite.com/e/defending-t…
I am incredibly honored to earn the trust and endorsement of President Donald J. Trump. I will never stop fighting for the state of Florida!

There’s a reason that so many America First organizations give me a perfect rating. I’m proud to have one of the most conservative records in the country — and as Governor, I will fight to defend the Florida Dream

A very special Memorial Day. Spent yesterday morning meeting amazing Florida veterans at the City of Jacksonville’s Memorial Day event before visiting the River Fest in Clay County.

This state is full of incredible Patriots honoring those who gave the ultimate sacrifice for our nation. Proud to be a Floridian and proud to be an American.

Texas, today is the day to get out and VOTE for @chiproytx to be your next Attorney General. I have served with Chip, and it's beyond any doubt that he is the true Conservative who will always fight for you and America! Texas, Vote Chip Roy for AG!

Video

“Greater love has no one than this.”

Those are the words of our Savior, and generations of Americans have lived them out in blood and sacrifice on battlefields a world away from home.

Today is a remembrance. It is a reckoning with the truth that every freedom we cherish, every right we hold, and every quiet morning with the people we love, was paid for by men and women who never came home.

To the Gold Star families across Florida and this great nation: we see you, we honor your loved ones tod

Like I always say — the best part of this journey is getting to meet wonderful Floridians in every corner of our great state. 

This sweet woman in The Villages was very fired up ahead of President Trump’s recent rally.

Video

Great night with the Orange County GOP celebrating 250 years of the greatest country on Earth! 

Leaders like my friend @WebsterCongress helped make Florida the strongest and freest state in America. 

We’re fighting everyday to keep Florida the blueprint for freedom. 🇺🇸

My favorite athlete of all time? Kobe.

He taught us to learn to love the hate. 

If you’re going to do anything in life, you’re going to have haters. 

Embrace it. Don’t run away from it.

That's Mamba Mentality.

Video

God will find you exactly where you are. Despite two arrests and many mistakes before I was 20, His grace and redemption found me in the summer of 2001 while at work. I heard the Lord tell me to "stop running," and I gave my life to Christ that very day. 🙏🏾

Video

When you’re dealing with a radical theocratic regime, you have to play hardball.

You can’t do Model UN negotiations. That’s how you get beat at the negotiating table.

Quite frankly, that’s how Obama got beat at the negotiating table.

Video

One thing is perfectly clear: the Cuban Regime is flat on its back.

They don't have the oil from Venezuela or support coming in from Russia.

That dictatorship would rather live high on the hog on the backs of the Cuban people than open the country so it can be a free society.

Video

✅ The Florida Dream

❌ Radical Liberal Lunacy

Democrats say they’re the only ones standing for freedom. 

Yet when President Trump takes action against murderous, anti-American dictators who oppress their people — suddenly Democrats have a problem.

Video

The Cuban Regime has to end.

Florida will fully cooperate with a FREE Cuba.

We WILL NOT cooperate with a new dictatorship.

Video

My hope is this trial in Florida so Mr. Castro faces a jury of his peers in the nation that stands for freedom, liberty and opportunity - not dictatorship. 
 
We want to see justice and justice will be done.
 
Don’t believe us? Go ask the former head of Venezuela.

Video

WATCH on today’s Castro indictment:


Rick Scott (@SenRickScott)

Senator Rick Scott and Members of Florida Delegation React to Raul Castro Indictment nitter.net/i/broadcasts/1aKbdbWAD…




— https://nitter.net/SenRickScott/status/2057166531868467670#m

Today’s indictment will help secure long-awaited justice for the people of Cuba and Cuban Americans. 

Extradite this murderous tyrant and have him stand trial in Florida so he can face the families of his many victims.


Fox News (@FoxNews)

BREAKING: Cuban ex-President Raul Castro indicted on charges including murder, conspiracy to kill US nationals



— https://nitter.net/FoxNews/status/2057142483587395968#m

The California Nightmare has nothing on the Florida Dream. Lower taxes. Safer cities. Freedom.

That’s the dream I’ll defend as Governor.
